To whom it may concern,
This letter intends to provide an update on the current tenant situation regarding the proposed Les
Schwabre-development of the apartment building located at 4605-4608Moran Ave.
As of Sept 12th2022, the current statusof the tenants is:
·All tenants were informed of the redevelopment in Juneof 2022.
·All tenants, current andprevious were promised a 60 dayvacation notice.
·5units are currently vacant due to tenants voluntarily securing other housing and moving out
on their own accord.
·2notices to vacate have been given to us(thelandlord)by tenants voluntarily who have
secured other housing.
·The remaining5units are occupied and are on a month-to-monthbasis.
·All tenants who have vacated thus far have been given back their full deposit at thetimeof
move out.
We acquired thebuilding in November2019.Since acquisition:
·Werepaired about a dozen or so issues ofhealth andhazard inherited from theprevious
windows, leaks, mold, lack of fire extinguishers, lack of properly functioning thermostats,
roach infestations, etc...
·We allowed flexible lease terms.
·We were very lenient with tenants about paying late, and never collected fees for doing so.
Prior to the buildings being demolished:
·Les Schwab has agreed tolet the landlord sell, recycle or repurpose any utilities or
stovefree of charge if it helps them with securing new housing.
In the current state, this building in our opinion does not provide a good opportunity for residential
housing.Given the age of thebuilding and systems, rents would need to drastically be increased to
justify thelevel of investment needed in maintaining this building as a residential building.Knowing
the potential of a better use, wewere able tohold off on increasing rents up with the anticipation of
re-development intoabetter usefor this location.
Please let me know if I could be of any further assistance orifI could clarify any of the points above.
Thank you,
Darko Vukovic,
Managing Member VIG Moran LLC
Phone #:+1650 485 9634
Email: drvukovic86@gmail.com
